parameters.name: Attribute
parameters.description:
The attribute of the ENI. Valid values:

attachment: member ENI attachment information of the trunk ENI. This value is in invitational preview and is not publicly available.

connectionTrackingConfiguration: connection tracking configuration.

Default value:

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ENI. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-network-interface-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --network-interface-id eni-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --attribute attachment --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Attribute attachment --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NetworkInterfaceId 'eni-bp67acfmxazb4p0000'
